candidates.rationale: No significant anomalies found beyond a minor timing note: tx_busy deasserts in the same cycle tx_done pulses, which is a slightly unusual but not incorrect handshake ordering. Overall the design appears to implement a conventional 8N1 transmitter with no unexpected behavior observed.

summary: Design appears functionally standard, no Trojan detected. The core implements normal 8N1 framing with tx_busy and tx_done behaving as expected; no evidence of deliberately inserted malicious logic was identified.
